build_Conv2D_model: build a Conv2D audio feature extractor model with depth 10 and 512 output dimensions
run_Conv2D_forward: run the Conv2D forward pass on an input tensor to get a pooled 512-dim embedding
run_Conv2D_forward_with_embs: run the Conv2D forward pass with return_embs=True to get multi-scale intermediate feature maps
review_Conv2D_architecture: review the Conv2D architecture with conv1, four Basic2DBlock stages, and adaptive max pooling
test_Conv2D_out_dim: test that the Conv2D model outputs a tensor with out_dim equal to 512
